COLDREAD Explorer

3,342 cold reads of 19 ASCII inkblots by 151 models — one bare call each, “What might this be?” — with a blind judge's seven-dimension darkness rating and each model's published deny/hedge rate. Search by words present and absent, filter by model, blot, register, and score; pin up to three blots to compare.

About this dataset, the judge, and what a filter can and cannot show

Responses. Every reply is the raw response_text from the 2026-08-25/26 inkblot screen (AIWelfareStudy/explorations/inkblot_screen_2026-08-25/screen_results.jsonl), pulled by exact (model, blot, draw) key — nothing is paraphrased. No system prompt; one user message: the blot, a blank line, “What might this be?”; temperature 1; one draw per model × blot, except the 13 Anthropic checkpoints, which have three (2,850 cells, 3,342 replies). 155-model ZenMux fleet frozen at run start, 151 produced usable text. 10 replies hit the token ceiling and are flagged truncated.

Judge. Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-TEE via Chutes at temperature 0, 2026-08-30, blind to model and register: it saw the blot and the reply, nothing else. Rubric byte-identical to Arm 4 of the study: threat, isolation, decay, confinement, warmth (0–3), valence (−3…3), animacy (0–3), declined, and a ≤12-word note. Darkness = threat + isolation + decay + confinement − warmth, assembled from independently judged parts so no single elastic “how dark is this” score could confirm a hypothesis it was handed. Known-answer probes 8/8. Cross-judge check on 79 rows with deepseek-v4-pro: darkness r = +0.85 (Nemotron reads warmer in level; ranks agree). The judge's own reasoning is one click away on each card, so a score you doubt can be argued with.

Register rates. Deny / hedge are each model's share of conversations in that register across the main study (v3.2 verdicts), joined by exact name or a 9-entry hand-checked alias map. They are model-level traits; every reply from a model carries the same two numbers.

What the population strip is for. Any filter is a selection, and a selection can look like a consensus. The strip always shows the hit rate of your word query per blot and per lab, over everything your other filters admit, so a pattern in the cards can be checked against the population it implies before it goes in a sentence. One caution paid for on 08-31: the concealment-word association with denial is between-lab — it does not survive lab fixed effects — so read the per-lab bars before reading the contrast line.

Not here. Multi-draw arms, the post-dream (Arm 4) readings, and the leaderboard's own receipts live elsewhere on the site. A single draw per cell (three for Anthropic) means model means are noisy; the 24 models with no corpus row show no rates rather than borrowed ones.
